attributes.name: Formless Adept
attributes.powers:
Reveal this card to ignore an effect that would shuffle your token card into a location deck. 

Discard this card to explore your location. If you encounter a barrier, a weapon, an armor, or an item, you may evade it; put it on the bottom of your location deck.
